fields.title: Channel / video / clip / schedule-segment record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Channel-mode records carry profile/live-status fields; videos/clips-mode records carry one row per item plus a channelLogin field and a _truncatedToFirstPage flag (Twitch's device-integrity gate blocks HTTP-only pagination beyond page 1 -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md); schedule-mode records carry one row per upcoming stream segment.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The channel login that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-gql, or none on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. channel_not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

isLive.title: Is live now
isLive.description: Channel mode only. True if a live stream object exists.

streamId.title: Live stream ID
streamId.description: Channel mode only, present only while live.

streamTitle.title: Live stream title
streamTitle.description: Channel mode only, present only while live.

streamType.title: Stream type
streamType.description: Channel mode only, present only while live.

viewersCount.title: Current viewers
viewersCount.description: Channel mode only, present only while live.

streamStartedAt.title: Live stream started at
streamStartedAt.description: Channel mode only, present only while live.

gameName.title: Game / category name
gameName.description: Channel mode (current game while live) or videos mode (per-video game).

gameBoxArtURL.title: Game box art URL
gameBoxArtURL.description: Channel mode only, present only while live.

tags.title: Stream tags
tags.description: Channel mode (current tags while live) or schedule mode (category names per segment).

channelLogin.title: Channel login
channelLogin.description: Videos / clips / schedule modes -- echoes the input login on every row.

channelTotalVideoCount.title: Total video count
channelTotalVideoCount.description: Videos mode only -- the channel's total video count on this connection, even though only the first page is returned.

_truncatedToFirstPage.title: Truncated to first page
_truncatedToFirstPage.description: Videos / clips modes -- true if more items exist beyond what this run returned (Twitch blocks deeper HTTP-only pagination).

title.title: Title
title.description: Videos mode (video title) or schedule mode (segment title, often blank).

url.title: URL
url.description: Videos mode (constructed VOD URL) or clips mode (clip URL, from upstream).

curatorLogin.title: Curator login
curatorLogin.description: Clips mode only -- the user who clipped it.

categories.title: Segment categories
categories.description: Schedule mode only -- planned game/category names for this segment.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across channel / video / clip / schedule records.
